twelveStagesData.name: growth
twelveStagesData.desc: As the first (or third, depending on interpretation) phase of the life cycle, this indicates an exception level of honesty, intelligence, and wholeness.  Excellence in creativity will help advance careers.  However, it is said that leadership position should be delayed until a later stage.

twelveStagesData.name: bath
twelveStagesData.desc: The Bath phase indicates capricious nature, with one often bouncing from one idea to the next, resulting in volatile friendship and career changes.  At the same time, one is plagued with a stubborn sense of self which can cause conflicts in relationships.

twelveStagesData.name: youth
twelveStagesData.desc: The beginning of the ascent. One sees potential on the horizon and will thrive to achieve success.  Stubborness persists as the climb continues.

twelveStagesData.name: thriving
twelveStagesData.desc: A positive phase -- one will stand with honor and sincerity.  Independence and authority will be sought-after as desires come through.

twelveStagesData.name: peak
twelveStagesData.desc: A phase with the strongest, confident energy.  A most auspicious phase, one will be proud and attention seeking, perhaps overly competitive.

twelveStagesData.name: aging
twelveStagesData.desc: As climax has been reached, this is a neutral phase as one maintains stabiility and restrained impulsiveness.  Modesty and acceptance overrides aspirations.

twelveStagesData.name: sickness
twelveStagesData.desc: The energy of body and mind are beginning decline. Social skills are refined as one is understanding of his or her place in the universe.

twelveStagesData.name: death
twelveStagesData.desc: One will be hesitant on important decisions and dwell on trivial matters.  Energy is on decline, and most find it difficult to stay in long term relationships.

twelveStagesData.name: grave
twelveStagesData.desc: One will become a closed shell who prefers to collect memories and linger on the past.  Difficult to open to change and societal fluctuations.  Correlated to introvertedness.

twelveStagesData.name: extinct
twelveStagesData.desc: Also known as the last stage before "reborn", this phase contains the weakest energy of all twelve stages.  Enthusiasm is at its lowest, and the soul is ready to begin anew.

twelveStagesData.name: conceived
twelveStagesData.desc: The womb is where it all begins.  A spark of curiosity and peculiarity light up the spirit.  Life becomes a playground, leading to a satisfying level of humbleness and humor.

twelveStagesData.name: nourishing
twelveStagesData.desc: At this phase, one is content.  As the last (or second, depending on interpretation) phase of the life cycle, one will carefully seek opportunities to develop.
